tei:div.tei:p: (407)༄༅// dbang chen rdo rje gro lod la brten nas srid pa'i 'dre lnga'i glud mdos btang tshul bzhugs// 1$0000280(408)

ye shes lnga ldan gnyug ma'i de nyid ston// kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang por gus btud de// dug lnga'i rang gzugs srid pa'i gdon tshogs la// yas kyis brngan zhing pha rol bkar thabs 'di'o// de la mdos gzhi sta stegs 'jam po la/ ri gling rol mtsho lcags ri rnams rdul tshon bkram pa'i khar rgyal khang pho brang thog rim gsum pa/ rtsig pa rnams ljang gu/ kha bad rnams dmar po/ steng du gser gyi rgya phib/ mtshams rnams su rgyal mtshan gzug de'i dbus sam mdun du rgyal po ban+de btsun gzugs/ g.yas su bud med nag mo bya rog mgo can/ mdun du byis pa/ g.yon du pho mtshan dmar po gyen 'greng*/ rgyab tu (409)khyi dmar po/ mtha' bskor du stag pa'i pho tang phrag g.yas mda' yis brgyan pa/ glang ma'i mo tang phrag g.yon 'phang gis brgyan pa/ smyug gis rgyang bu bal tshon kha dog sna tshogs rim pa gsum du brgyan pa/ nam mkha' kha dog sna tshogs bya spus brgyan pa/ smyug ma'i mda' bkra dar gyis brgyan pa/ bsom shing 'phang bkra snal mas brgyan pa/ shing ris la/ dong tshe/ mig mang*/ rtags brgyad/ sna bdun/ yul 'khor/ sa gzhi/ rgya mtsho/ ri rab/ nyi zla gza' skar/ 'ja' tshon/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ cang shes rta/ ma rmos lo tog dpag bsam shing*/ gter chen bum pa/ bdud (410)rtsi'i mtsho rnams bris pa bcas de rnams brgya rtsa'am lo grangs tsam gzug snod gcig tu sbyin bdag gi 'dra glud khru gang las mi chung ba la glud rdzas/ zer mo'i sgro/ lung thang*/ dar dmar/ bse ru/ mtshal/ dung*/ spu shel rtse/ dbang lag shel/ mgron bu/ byi ru/ mu tig snying dang mkhal ma zho sha a ru ra/ me shel/ chu shel/ gser dngul/ lcags zangs/ ku ba/ rdo rus/ chu srin sder mo/ zas sman/ gos dar/ snam bu/ 'bru dang bcas pa sna 'dus/ g.yas su lho rdzas/ rtsod/ rgya skag zhu mkhan sogs/ g.yon du byang rdzas lan tshwa/ bul tog sogs/ mdun rgyab tu la rdzas/ tsha la la btsas rdo/

klung rdzas bye ma/ sgog btsang*/ zam shing sogs gang (411)'dzom dang*/ mar me lnga/ ting lo drug sha dum brgyad/ 'brang rgyas lnga/ gtor chung bcu gnyis/ gzugs 'gros rigs/ pho chas/ mo chas sogs srid pa'i dkor cha rigs/ mtha' bskor nam rgyang mda' 'phang pho tang mo tang sogs kyis bskor/ mdos la 'bul rgyu/ chang bu/ zan chad rnams lo grangs/ glud la bsngo rgyur/ dri khus sbrus pa'i chang bu/ glud chung*/ ting lo/ mar me rnams lo grangs/ gnyis dkar/ sha dum/ zas sna/ gos sna/ sen mo/ 'bru sna/ shel tshig sogs gang 'byor bshams pa dang*/ bdag bskyed mchod gtor sogs 'og tu nye bar mkho ba rnams kyang bsdog go dngos gzhi la/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ dkar bgegs (412)nas brtsams/ tshogs lhag ma yan grub nas/ bdag bskyed zhal bsgyur ba ni/ gzhung las/ hrīḥ bla ma bde mchog 'khor lo ni/ sogs nas/ dam tshig ye shes gnyis med gsal/ bar dang*/ mdos byin gyis brlab pa ni/ las rnams la chab bran te/ gterabadag gling pa'i gsung*/ bdag nyid bcom ldan shā kya thub// phyag rgya'i yi ge a dkar las// 'od 'phros gtor rdzas dngos 'dzin gyi// drim sbyangs nas stong par gyur/ thal mo khong stong sbyar la/ oṃ swa bha ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharma ཿswa bhā ba shud+dho3 haṃ/ chos (413)nyid rnam dag phyag rgya sngags// ting 'dzin ldan pas gtor rdzas kyi// 'bag btsog nyams grib nyes skyon dang*// mtshan 'dzin dri ma dag gyur cig de nas gzhung las/ stong pa'i ngang las rten 'byung 'gags pa med pa'i sogs nas/ gter chen por gyur/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ bdag nyid bcom ldan rnam snang mdzad// phyag rgya'i yi ge khaṃ sngon las// 'od 'phros gtor rdzas zad med mdzod// nam mkha'i khams kun khyab par gyur/ thal mo (414)khong stong smin mtshams su bskor zhing*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/

nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya sngags// ting 'dzin bden pas gtor rdzas rnams// bskal pa'i bar du zad mi shes// rgya chen nam mkha' gang gyur cig /bdag nyid bcom ldan bdud rtsi 'khyil// phyag rgya'i yi ge hrīḥdamar las// 'od 'phros gtor rdzas ye shes kyi// bdud rtsi chen po'i rang bzhin gyur/(415) mthe bong bsnol/ sor mo gdengs pa kha'i thad bzhag cing*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor phyag rgya sngags// ting 'dzin bden pas gtor rdzas rnams// bdud rtsi ye shes lnga yi dngos// 'chi sos dug lnga'i sman gyur cig /bdag nyid bcom ldan rin chen 'byung*// phyag rgya'i yi ge trāṃ ser las// 'od 'phros gtor rdzas 'dod yon lnga*// so so'i mos pa ji bzhin gyur/ khu tshur g.yon snying gar/ g.yas mdzub mo rdzas (416)la gtod/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐ḥ rgya chen shugs ldan phyag rgya sngags// ting 'dzin ldan pas gtor rdzas rnams// dbang po'i spyod yul tshim byed pa'i// 'dod yon sna tshogs char 'bebs shog /bdag nyid bcom ldan don yod grub// phyag rgya'i yi ge ha ljang las// 'od 'phros mchog dman skal pa bzhin// 'thab rtsod med par thob par gyur/ g.yas khu tshur snying gar/ g.yon mchog sbyin/ oṃ dz+nyā na a ba lo ki (417)te na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha ba sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du rudu ru hri da ya dz+wa la ni hūm̐/ ye shes skar mda'i phyag rgya sngags// ting 'dzin bden pas mgron rnams kun// ma rgyal 'khrugs rtsod med par thob// dgyes shing re ba gang gyur cig bdag nyid bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin// phyag rgya'i yi ge dzaḥdamar las// 'od 'phros mgron rnams dbang du 'dus// phrin las gang 'dod sgrub par gyur/ sor mo nang bsnol/ (418)mthe bong sgreng ba spyi bor bskor/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ gra he shwa ra pra bha dz+ye ti ni ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/

dbang sgyur 'khor lo'i phyag rgya sngags// ting 'dzin ldan pas mgron rigs kun// bdag gis dbang 'dus gang bcol las// sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzad gyur cig ces sngags drug phyag drug gis sbyang spel bsgyur thob tshim dbang du byed pa'i nus ldan du bya/ de nas mgron bsdu ba ni/ hrīḥ ngang nyid dbyings las rang snang ba'iḥ sogs nas/ srid pa'i mdos la da tshur shog: bar gzhung ltar rjes/ (419)bden pas 'gugs pa ni/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bca' la/ kunamakhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i gsung*/ na mo/ drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rigs sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis (420)rnal 'byor pa dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa/ zhe sdang rang gar bzung ba'i btsun pa rang rgyud rgyal po/ 'dod pa rang rgyud brten pa'i btsun ma gson bdud 'dre mo/ nga rgyal rmongs par zhen pa'i byis pa the'u rang ja la/ phrag dog 'dzin pas bcing pa'i sngags pa sems ngan dam sri/ dug lnga rang stobs bsdo ba'i sde dpon ma rungs yul 'dre/ lo rgyal po'i keg zla ba blon po'i keg zhag dmag mi'i keg(421)dus tshod mtshon cha'i keg gzhan yang keg su brgya drug stong*/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga/ ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu/ glo bur dgu bcu rtsa gcig dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad/ bdud bzhi tshe yi bar gcod/ rgyal bsen dam sri the'u rang*/ mo 'dre bse rag chung sri/ god sri dgra sri phung sri/ nad sri yams kyi bdag po/ rgab 'dre yul (422)'dre 'khyams po la sogs pa/

gnod byed 'byung po thams cad glud gtor len pa la mchis par gyur cig oṃ badz+ra ṭak+ki rā dza dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sarba big nan aṅku sha ya dzaḥ zhes lan gsum gyis bkug la/ rang gzhung gis/ srid pa mdos kyi rwa ba 'dir: sogs nas/ rdo rje 'chang gi bka' la nyon: bar gyi rten la bstim/ de nas theb tser/ chang bu/ zan chad/ sha dum/ zas sna/ gos sna/ sen mo/ 'bru sna/ shol tshig sogs bshams/ chu gtsang (chang )gis bran la/ tshar re bzhin mdos gtor du blugs pa dang bsgrags te/ sam+bha ra/ (423)lan gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod nas/ kyaiḥ srid pa'i 'dre lnga 'khor dang bcasaḥ sogs nas/ phyin chad gnod pa ma ston cig: ces pa'i sbyin bdag gi lo grangs 'gro nges su bsogs/ de nas glud 'phyang ni/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i gsung rab thugs mchog rdo rje'i gter ma/ hūm̐: srid pa'i 'dre lnga 'khor dang bcasaḥ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dang : glud dang yas la dbang ba yi: bgegs rigs 'byung po'i tshogs bcas la: sku glud rgyan ldan bsngo ba ni: ya mtshan ltad (424)mo 'di ltar lags: mthing gi skra lo nyi li li: mgo sig ral pa yengs se yeng: shel gyi klad pa lung thang mig: lta stangs mig 'gyur hrig ge hrig: sna mdzes mgron bu ya la la: bye ru'i lce la rna ba dung : smra brjod sgra snyan lams se lam: dar skud rtsa la mu tig byams: mnyen lcug dri med nyigs se nyig: zho sha'i snying la a ru'i sha: bsam dang bkra mdangs ya la la: mtshal gyi khrag la chu shel rus: bcud dang zhag g.yo me (425)re re: me shel drod la rlung gi dbugs: bag gro sna bshug kyu ru ru: rin chen sman lnga'i nang khrol ldan: kun tshang dbang po nyi li li: lag pa g.yas g.yon gser dang dngul: phyag rgya pad skor lings se ling : rkang pa g.yas g.yon lcags dang zangs: rdog bro gar stabs khyugs se khyug: sku gsung thugs la mar me lnga:

sku lnga rang byung ta la la: dbang po rnams la ting lo drug: tshogs drug (426)ma 'gags na ra ra: rnam shes brgyad la sha dum brgyad: skye gnas rnam bzhi byad dang ldan: phung khams lnga la 'brang rgyas lnga: 'byung ba'i bcud ldan khrigs se khrig: skye mched gtor chung bcu gnyis te: srid pa'i spyod 'gros kun kyang tshang : 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i na bza' gsol: snang srid kun gyi yid sems 'phrog: dkor nor shel tshig dpag yas stong ཿ mnga' thang rgyal po chas pa 'dra: bang ba khyim gang yas thag glud: tshong (427)dpon lam du chas pa 'dra: gri khrab go mtshon rgyan dang ldan: dpa' bo dgra la chas pa 'dra: gser g.yu dar zab khro lo lo: mo btsun bag mar chas pa 'dra: bzhad gad rtse gar khrigs se khrig: lha phrug rtse rar tshogs pa 'dra: de bas ya mtshan ldan pa'i glud: mi bas glud dga' ngo mtshar che: mi la ya mtshan gang yang med: khog stod dug lnga'i me ltar 'bar: khog smad mi gtsang mtsho(428)ltar 'khyil: tshe rabs bag chags mun ltar gtibs: las sgrib can gyi mi'u bskyur: yon tan ldan pa'i glud 'di longs: snang srid lha 'dre'i phyag tu 'bul: lan chags bu lon 'khor gyur cig: sha 'khon sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: bla med byang chub reg gyur cig: ces brjod/ de nas/ snod du/ glud chung*/ dri mas sbag pa'i chang bu/ ting lo/ mar me/ sha dum sogs bshams nas tshar re bzhin blud du dor ba dang sbrag sam+bha ra lan gsum/ mtshan bzhi bcas dang*/ kyaiḥ mi (429)bas glud bzang ya mtshan che: sogs nas/ bsngo zhing sbyin pas tshim gyur cig: ces pa'i bar gzhung ltar lo grangs kyi bar du brjod/ rdzogs pa dang sgo dbye gser skyems ni/ yum ka'i seng gdong gtor bzlog las/ hūm̐ḥ dbang po rdo rje can la sogs: phyogs skyong chen po bcu rnams dang : rgyal chen bzhi sogs gdon gyi bdag: rang rang 'khor dang bcas pa dang : gnam sa'i sgra gcan sa'i lha mo:

dus mtshan thun phyed rwa hu dang : biṣ+ṭi dus la (430)dbang ba'i lha: rtag chags yul lha gnyan po rnams: gser skyems brngan sbyin 'di bzhes la: sgo phye 'phrang sol mdos lam phye: sems med 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i: klong du dgra bgegs dmigs byas nas: mdos sna dgra la gtod byed na: sems ldan ko long mi 'tshal te: dbu chum zhabs bsdus sku gzur la: rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings la bzhugs: dkar phyogs srung ba'i grogs dan mdzod: (431) ces brjod/ las byang gi thugs dam bskul/ chad tho btang nas lam bstan cing brdzang ba ni/ mdos glud rnams kha phyir bsgyur la/ thugs mchog rdo rje'i gter ma/ hūm̐: da ni bgegs la lam bstan 'tshal: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: ri rab chen po'i byang phyogs na: rin chen gser gyi pho brang na: longs spyod mi zad dkor nor yod: yid mtshar pho mo grangs med yod: de ru khyod kyi lam bstan no: bgegs kyi (432)sa yul de ru che: bgegs kyi 'du tshogs de ru bzang : ya ga dmos pa'i mi rnams kyis: bgegs rgyal de ru byon zhes zer: mgron dang ston mo grabs yod skad: de ru bgegs pa la lam bstan no: 'di ru sdod pa'i gnas ma mchis: yul yang drag po e yi klong : phyi nang khyab pa'i me dpung 'khrigs: mi rnams khro bo khro mo ste: drag sngags hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar ldir: chas rnams dur khrod (433)drag po'i chas: bgegs dpung 'joms pa'i mtsho char 'bebs: de bas chags pa'i gnas ma mchis: gdug pa'i bsam pa zhi bar mdzod: chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung : de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs: rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa: dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs: sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing : dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad: (434)rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul: 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin: bde mchog 'khor lo'i bka' ma bcag: sogs nas/ chos rnams thams cad de ltar blta:

zhes brjod nas srung bya'i lo bdud kyi steng du btang ngo*/ de nas srung 'khor sgom/ gsol ka bskyangs/ bstan ma/ bro mnan/ rjes chog mchod bstod bshags pa/ dngos grub bla ba/ rten bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ 'di'i phan yon ni/ tshe nyams pa/ bla nyams pa/ srid pa'i byol zor/ chags che ba/ nyam nga ba/ mo ngan pa/ rmi lam ngan pa/ (435)than dang ltas ngan/ dmag dang 'khrugs rtsod/ ngan smras gleng mo/ lo nyes pa/ phyugs nyams pa/ skyes pa'i pho sri/ bud med kyi mo sri/ byis pa'i chung sri/ gnas gzhi dang*/ yul khams brlag pa/ dam chos sgrub pa'i bar gcod sogs/ mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'joms shing phun sum tshogs pa'i legs tshogs spel ba la tshig nyung zhing don 'dus pa/ kha 'dum la chod che ba/ byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'bar ba 'di nyid bdag legs su 'dod pa (rbas )rnams kyis g.yar dmar du bya ba rigs so// stong nyid snying rje 'brel ba'i yas dang glud// ma rig gzung 'dzin (436)dug lnga'i gdon la sbyin// 'khrul pa'i rdzun ris 'od gsal dbyings su zhi// 'phral yun phan bde'i dpal la rol gyu cig /ces kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po'i rdo rje'i gsung srid pa'i 'dre lnga'i glud bsdus kyi zur 'debs su kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i gsung rab las byung ba'i glud 'phyong gis brgyan te dpal chen 'dus pas bris pa dge legs 'phel/// //////////////////////////////////
